newsitem.title: GERMANY: SKS Logistics plans common int'l standards.
newsitem.headline: SKS Logistics plans common int'l standards.

text.p: German freight forwarder SKS Logistics International said it aims to develop common international standards for global logistics services by its foreign partner agents.
The expanding forwarder said in a statement that 55 agents from partner companies in 22 countries met in London to develop joint international standards.
Asian agents included representatives from China, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Vietnam and Malaysia, the statement added.

SKS Logistics International managing director Alfred Lowski said: "Only firms which can guarantee worldwide, comprehensive first-class standards and have qualified staff will be successful long-term."

SKS Logistics International, a subsidiary of Suedkraft Sueddeutsche Kraftwagen-Speditions-GmbH, part of the Heidelberger Zement AG group, was formed in June to operate the firm's international air and sea freight activities.

In August it took a 40 percent stake in Singapore-based forwarder Rhenus Transport Pte as a launching pad for expansion in south-east Asia. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
